# Pulse task #2857: Invalidate stale vendored GPUI metadata on shared-target worktree handoff

Operation: 92e99ea6b269ced0c251ecdf3144ec58
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

Observed during EQ PR407 exact candidate bd819941891101d024e293833fd22d402136bd09 focused compilation, independently of the EQ semantic changes. Pulse2801 note28095 records session13014/PID1002710 terminal101: hex-widgets E0609/E0560 for ScrollWheelEvent.is_momentum even though current third_party/gpui source declares the field (interactive.rs SHA256 e72427052aa9bdf43015f24612d1f721816f372ddcfade4ec9ee3168353158ee). GPUI was not recompiled; checked-out source mtime1792371975 preceded reused old GPUI fingerprint1792399113. The merger preserved negative log and full fingerprint/source/timestamp inventory at artifacts/integration/407-bd819941-stale-gpui-negative.json, then after the job was terminal cleared only gpui development artifacts (66files/359.9MiB) and rebuilt exact unchanged source. Rebuild result remains separate; no product DSP failure or passing retry claimed here.

Related historical issue2144 (PR60, merged20e8f611...) implemented cooperative target ownership and workspace-package invalidation while deliberately preserving dependency caches. Do not reopen or relabel its accepted finite scope. This follow-up covers vendored/path dependency provenance, specifically GPUI, across source worktrees whose timestamps can predate cached metadata. Inspect current runner's actual target/worktree ownership path and Cargo fingerprints before choosing implementation; source changes in the EQ PR are not the repair.

Acceptance: a real isolated Cargo fixture with two worktrees and a vendored path dependency API/field change, including older checkout mtimes, cannot silently reuse incompatible dependency metadata. Invalidate/rebuild the affected vendored dependency and any necessary dependents under the existing exclusive target lock, or demonstrate another bounded strategy. Record source/target/dependency identity and exact negative→positive evidence. Preserve unrelated external dependency artifacts, release artifacts, logs, historical bundles and active target owners; refuse lock contention or unknown ownership before mutation. No whole-target cleaning, hidden source touching, assertion weakening, new workflow authority or hosted CI. Run repository-owned local checks on the exact candidate. Keep one canonical PR, assign/review PORTALSURFER per project rules. This is queued maintenance; no extra worker or concurrent implementation is authorized by this record.
